title: Institutions Just Bought the Fear (4 Stocks to Buy Now)
creator: MarketBeat
source_note: Detailed summary generated from video captions
summary: In "Institutions Just Bought the Fear (4 Stocks to Buy Now)," published ~11pm UK on 7 Oct 2026, MarketBeat hosts guest Pete Carmacito of Chaken Analytics, who makes the institutional-accumulation case for four software names beaten down in the Q1 "AI will eat software" selloff and rebounding since late July: institutions bought the lows, momentum/money-flow indicators flipped (his validation signal), and a coming "American Atlas" catalyst road-map from Chaken Analytics frames the pitch. Four BUYs, no flips, no stated prices — all first-ever MarketBeat-tracked calls. CRM — BUY: Salesforce "very bullish long term" — smart-money accumulation, agentic-AI first-mover, CRM near-unreplaceable in enterprise; chart turning point, still below analyst targets; bull case: a "dark-fiber moment" — cheap AI compute layered onto captive customer data. CRWD — BUY: "absolute own right now" — pure-play cybersecurity at 52-week highs; AI bad-actor risk makes it a "have to have." PANW — BUY: cybersecurity powerhouse #2 alongside CrowdStrike, plus networking/software components; price momentum is the trigger, AI-fear headlines the tailwind. VEEV — BUY: overlooked pharma-software lifeblood (sales through R&D), "a lot of legs"; chart turning point, big pharma buying more of its services. These are guest picks, all first calls on record.

calls.thesis: Guest Pete Carmacito is 'very bullish long term' on Salesforce: institutions and smart money accumulated through the Q1 software selloff, momentum and money-flow indicators have flipped (the 'validation' he waits for), and it was oversold 'for no reason at all'. Salesforce was the first to push agentic AI; CRM stickiness is near-unreplaceable for enterprise.
calls.base_case: Chart has formed a turning point and recovered sharply since end of July; still trades well below analyst targets.
calls.bull_case: AI-first CRM that owns the enterprise customer dataset benefits from a 'dark fiber' moment — cheap AI compute layered onto data customers can't leave.

calls.thesis: Called 'an absolute own right now': pure-play cybersecurity at the top of its 52-week range with price momentum validated; cybersecurity is 'not a nice to have, a have to have' as AI gives bad actors new attack surfaces — he advises owning both CRWD and PANW.
calls.base_case: AI-fear headlines are a direct tailwind; more firms adopt layered protection to use AI safely.
calls.bull_case: Never been more important to have cybersecurity; AI models won't replace the security layer, they make it essential.

calls.thesis: Palo Alto is the second cybersecurity 'powerhouse' alongside CrowdStrike — adds networking and software components to the pure play; paired recommendation is to own both, with price momentum on both names the trigger and validated indicator.
calls.base_case: Already in a momentum phase for several months; same AI-fear tailwind as CrowdStrike.
calls.bull_case: Valuation concerns exist, but price dictates direction and it's moving — AI adoption expands the protected surface indefinitely.

calls.thesis: Overlooked pharma-software name that 'runs pharmaceutical companies' end to end — sales through R&D — with 'a lot of legs' left; chart is at a turning point like the other three.
calls.base_case: Rebounded nicely but still in the 'opportunity zone'; big pharma keeps buying more of its services.
calls.bull_case: The cornerstone of medical R&D commercialization; AI in drug research multiplies demand for the secure data platform pharma already depends on.
